decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single-storey rear extension, as shown on drawings numbered 2 Gould Rd Sheet 1 of 4 and 2 Gould Rd Sheet 2 of 4, received 21st November 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered to be an acceptable design response with regard to position, bulk, scale, materials and appearance. It is considered that the development would not result in any significant adverse impacts upon the amenity of the existing site, adjoining and neighbouring properties or street scene. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house.
